description: THE OPERATING GUIDE for driving the tia_* tools — read the relevant topic BEFORE authoring, changing hardware or preparing a deploy. Returns bundled markdown: gates vs guards (G1..G7 are human-only), the build pipeline (validate→plan→scaffold→verify→handoff), runtime-validated gotchas, GUI-gate handoffs, the bare-CPU protection recipe, and the project-spec format. Default topic 'toc' lists the chapters; 'full' returns everything. Pure/offline (class R): does NOT call the serve — works with the serve down.

topic.description: one of: toc | full | codex | brief | gates-guards | gui-gates | gotchas | pipeline | recipes | spec-format (default "toc")
